building: Alpha Gamma Delta, Beta Xi Chapter

sources.provider: Purdue University official campus building footprint service
sources.measurement_method: 30 distinct WGS 84 footprint vertices transformed to project-local campus XY using the documented repository approximation; opened .blend base vertices compared to every source ring point.
sources.observation: FID 757 / SOAGD identifies Alpha Gamma Delta at 1010 David Ross Road. The polygon area attribute is 1785.996 m2. It reports NUM_LEVELS=1 and Extrution=40, but the service publishes no definitions or units for these fields.
sources.uncertainty: Campus GIS is not a certified survey and gives no positional accuracy, structural edge convention, vertical datum, or extrusion field definition.

sources.provider: Alpha Gamma Delta Fraternity Housing Corporation (property operator)
sources.measurement_method: Operator property listing, no geometry measurements taken.
sources.observation: Lists the Beta Xi house at 1010 David Ross Road, capacity 74, year built 1965, and size 23,288 square feet. The page links to property images; no drawing, field dimensions, or elevation is supplied.
sources.uncertainty: The published square footage is not identified as footprint area or a particular gross-area convention. It is not directly comparable to the GIS polygon area.

sources.provider: Meyer Najem, construction manager project portfolio
sources.measurement_method: Project description; renovation scope, no new dimensions inferred.
sources.observation: Confirms a 5,000-square-foot renovation to an existing sorority house and describes the project as a two-story house.
sources.uncertainty: 5,000 square feet is the renovation scope, not a whole-building area or measured footprint; the page supplies no elevations or roof plan.

sources.provider: Two Tulips Boutique, Purdue sorority-house illustration by Courtney Day
sources.measurement_method: Commercial custom illustration explicitly identified as 1010 David Ross Road; visual vocabulary only, not scaled or treated as a measured elevation.
sources.observation: The stylized drawing depicts a two-story cream-colored house with a pitched roof, a columned entrance, red double doors, Greek letters, and front shrubs.
sources.uncertainty: Illustration is not a construction drawing or georeferenced photograph; proportions, exact materials, roof footprint, entrance side and details are approximate.

sources.provider: Purdue University Fraternity, Sorority and Cooperative Life / Panhellenic Association
sources.measurement_method: Chapter identity cross-check; no dimensions inferred.
sources.observation: Lists the Purdue Alpha Gamma Delta chapter and links its official chapter website.

coordinate_transform.project_frame: Meters; X east, Y north, Z up; campus origin latitude 40.4274, longitude -86.9137
coordinate_transform.limitation: Project-local approximation, not a surveyed projected CRS.

modeling_decisions.footprint: Preserve all 30 official polygon vertices at the building base; verified in the reopened library.
modeling_decisions.floors: Two modeled stories, supported by the contractor project description and operator house illustration; GIS NUM_LEVELS=1 conflicts and its field convention is undocumented.
modeling_decisions.height: Estimated eaves 7.6 m and ridge 10.0 m; no measured elevation or structural drawing found.
modeling_decisions.roof: A compact central gable with low roof membrane over the remaining mapped outline is an illustrative interpretation; the exact roof plan is not known.
modeling_decisions.entry: Columned porch and red double-door vocabulary follows the exact-address commercial illustration. West-facing longest-edge placement is only a model approximation, since source imagery is not georeferenced.
modeling_decisions.materials: Cream walls, light trim, charcoal roof, and red doors are schematic color choices informed by the illustration; not measured or confirmed from an authoritative photo.
